# Position Trained Requirements

A Trained Leader is a registered adult. Youth Protection Training is a joining
requirement for all registered adults and must be retaken every two years
(some Councils require it to be retaken every year.

Adult leaders in units are considered “trained” and eligible to wear the
official Trained emblem when they have completed Youth Protection Training and
the training courses outlined in the linked document below.

[Trained Leader Requirements (Updated December
2024)](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Position-Trained-
Requirements-Dec2024v2.pdf)



![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/09/Trained_patch_green.jpg)
